applicability: The install procedure and the documents that state the install and start: the c-13 skill, docs/install/README.md, the settings reference, the readmes, the runtime_install registration/description and the command help texts.
conditions: Each text states rules 1 to 6 and 8 to 10 as far as it covers them, and the generated harness copies are regenerated with the existing commands.
exclusions: No text tells a user to run the provision as a step of an install; the terminal provision stays the explicit transition only.
